QF.id: XVI Clearing, Settlement and Risk Management_55

question.text: The primary responsibilities of the Clearing Corporation include all EXCEPT:

answer.text: Providing investment advisory or research services to market participants
Collection of margins on a timely basis

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the source workbook, the clearing corporation's responsibilities include margin collection, daily clearing and settlement, acting as the legal counterparty, position monitoring, Settlement Guarantee Fund management, and managing defaults. Investment advisory or research services are not part of the clearing corporation's role. The Trap: The other three options are all listed responsibilities of the clearing corporation. Advisory and research services are performed by brokers, investment advisers, or research analysts — not by the clearing corporation. Note: Distributor/cross-exam coaching labels replaced with neutral wording.
